lamps.steady: An SRS airbag system malfunction has been detected. Have your vehicle inspected by a professional immediately.
A front or rear seat belt is unfastened. Fasten it to turn the warning light off.
lamps.flashing: Flashes when driving without fastened seat belts or when unfastened at speeds above 20 km/h.

lamps.steady: One or more doors are not closed securely. Ensure all doors are fully closed.
Indicates a malfunction in LED headlamps, other lights, or High Beam Assist. Look at LCD display for details.

lamps.lamp: Motor Driven Power Steering (MDPS) warning light
lamps.steady: Power steering malfunction detected. Have the vehicle checked immediately by an authorised Kia dealer.
The tailgate is not closed securely. Check and close it.
There is a malfunction with the LED headlamp. Have it checked by a professional.
lamps.flashing: An LED headlamp related part is malfunctioning. Have it inspected by a professional.

lamps.steady: The fuel tank is nearly empty. Add fuel as soon as possible.
An emission control, engine, or powertrain malfunction has occurred. Have the vehicle checked by a professional.
Engine oil pressure is low. Check oil level immediately and add oil as required.
Engine oil pressure is dangerously low. Stop safely, turn off engine, check oil level, and add oil.
Water has accumulated inside the fuel filter. Remove water from the filter immediately.
PPF malfunction. Drive over 80 km/h at 1500-4000 rpm for 30+ minutes to clear soot.
lamps.flashing: PPF malfunction persists. Have the system checked by a professional workshop.

lamps.lamp: Exhaust system (DPF or LNT) warning light (Diesel Engine)
lamps.steady: DPF or LNT malfunction. Drive over 60 km/h at 1500-2500 rpm for 25 minutes to clear.
lamps.flashing: Exhaust system issue continues. Have the vehicle checked by a professional workshop.

lamps.steady: Urea solution tank is nearly empty. Refill the urea solution as soon as possible.
Alternator or charging system malfunction. Stop safely and check the alternator drive belt.
Outside temperature is below 4°C (40°F). Roads may be icy, drive carefully.

lamps.lamp: Parking brake and brake fluid warning light
lamps.steady: Parking brake is applied, or brake fluid level is critically low. Seek service if fluid is low.
The EPB is malfunctioning. Have the vehicle checked by a professional workshop.
lamps.flashing: The EPB has not been applied properly. Cycle the EPB switch.

lamps.steady: ABS is malfunctioning. Regular braking works, but seek professional assistance.
Both ABS and regular braking systems are failing. Drive carefully, avoid high speeds, and stop safely.
Forward Collision-Avoidance Assist is disabled, deselected, or malfunctioning.
lamps.flashing: Blinks red when Forward Safety or Forward Cross-Traffic Safety is operating.

lamps.steady: Forward/Side Safety function is disabled, deselected, or malfunctioning.
lamps.flashing: Blinks red when Forward/Side Safety function is operating.

lamps.steady: One or more tyres are significantly underinflated. Check and inflate tyres immediately.
lamps.flashing: Flashes for 60 seconds then stays steady to indicate a TPMS malfunction.

lamps.steady: High beams are turned on or turn signal is set to flash-to-pass.
Indicates a turn signal malfunction if it stays steady, does not light, or blinks rapidly.
lamps.flashing: Blinks normally when turn signals are active.

lamps.steady: Vehicle successfully detected the key's immobiliser. Turns off after starting.
lamps.flashing: Immobiliser system is malfunctioning. Have the vehicle checked.

lamps.steady: Smart key detected inside vehicle. Disappears after engine starts.
lamps.flashing: Smart key battery is weak, key is missing, or system is malfunctioning.

lamps.steady: The front fog lights are turned on.
Engine is preheating. Start the engine once the light goes out.
lamps.flashing: Preheating system malfunction if it blinks after driving or warming up.

lamps.steady: The taillights or headlights are turned on.
Displays current drive mode (NORMAL, ECO, or SPORT).
DBC is turned on, or yellow if the system is malfunctioning.
lamps.flashing: Blinks green when DBC is actively operating.

lamps.steady: White when activated, green when holding vehicle still, yellow when malfunctioning.
ESC system malfunction. Have the vehicle checked by a professional.
lamps.flashing: Blinks when the ESC system is actively operating.

lamps.lamp: Electronic stability control (ESC) OFF indicator light
lamps.steady: The ESC system has been turned off.
The Smart Cruise Control system is enabled.
Gray when conditions unmet, green when met/active, yellow if disabled or malfunctioning.
lamps.flashing: Blinks green when Lane Keeping Assist is actively operating.

lamps.steady: Green when function is active, yellow when malfunctioning.
Light switch is set to AUTO and high beams are on with HBA active.
Driver Attention Warning is disabled or malfunctioning.
lamps.flashing: Blinks yellow to recommend taking a break from driving.

lamps.lamp: Front passenger air bag ON/OFF indicator
lamps.steady: Shows whether the passenger's front airbag is enabled or disabled.

lamps.lamp: Check side view mirror warning light
lamps.steady: Outside rearview mirror warning light or Safe Exit Warning is malfunctioning.
